answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The dawn lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ridge is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
